problem_statement:
Bug#33897859: Unexpected behaviour seen with revoking a privilege from role.

No error was shown while revoking non-existent privilege in case the user/role
has granted any other privileges, while ER_NONEXISTING_GRANT should be issued.

Fix in replace_db_table():

- Added variable old_rights containing rights that existed before the operation.
  This new variable allows for easy checking:
  - if the row existed,
  - if all privileges being revoked exist
  - if any privilege being granted is a new one
- if any of the above condition fails the function reports ER_NONEXISTING_GRANT
- In case partial_revokes=ON allow for multiple revokes
  (similar to multiple grants)
- Assure backward compatibility for replication scenarios: if
  original_server_version is "old" behave the old way
- In case of GRANT ALL behave the old way
- Tidy up call to report_missing_user_grant_message
